lines.zh: 我在浅水里拖着腿走，腐肉在袋里晃。
lines.en: I drag my legs through the shallows, rotten flesh sloshing in my pouch.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩出浑水，我走得很慢。
lines.en: Every step stirs up cloudy water, and I move slowly.

lines.zh: 藤壶刮着我的膝盖，我照样往前走。
lines.en: Barnacles scrape my knees, and I keep walking anyway.

lines.zh: 我脚踝上挂着水草，甩不掉。
lines.en: Weed hangs off my ankle and I cannot shake it loose.

lines.zh: 水面没过腰，我把腐肉举高了些。
lines.en: Water reaches my waist, so I lift the rotten flesh higher.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，水都变成褐色。
lines.en: The water turns brown everywhere I pass.

lines.zh: 我的腿在水下发软，还是没停。
lines.en: My legs go soft underwater, but I do not stop.

lines.zh: 我拐着走，像被水推着往前。
lines.en: I limp along as if the water is pushing me.

lines.zh: 泥从脚趾缝里挤出来，我没理会。
lines.en: Mud squeezes between my toes and I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我沿着河床走，找能扔的东西。
lines.en: I walk the riverbed looking for something to throw.

lines.zh: 一缕头发浮在水面，跟着我动。
lines.en: A strand of my hair floats on the surface, following me.

lines.zh: 我不喘气，走路却带着喘的声音。
lines.en: I do not breathe, yet my walking still sounds like panting.

lines.zh: 我站在水里，让水流过肋骨。
lines.en: I stand in the water and let it run through my ribs.

lines.zh: 肺里灌满了水，我不用它呼吸。
lines.en: My lungs are full of water; I do not use them.

lines.zh: 我数着袋里的腐肉，一共九块。
lines.en: I count the rotten flesh in my pouch: nine pieces.

lines.zh: 水底有铜的光，我盯了很久。
lines.en: Copper glints on the riverbed and I stare at it a long while.

lines.zh: 我一张嘴，只冒出一串泡。
lines.en: I open my mouth and only bubbles come out.

lines.zh: 我在等潮水把味道带过来。
lines.en: I am waiting for the current to bring a scent.

lines.zh: 我的皮肤泡得发白，指甲还在长。
lines.en: My skin is pale from soaking, yet my nails still grow.

lines.zh: 水面上的光晃得我眼疼。
lines.en: The light on the surface makes my eyes ache.

lines.zh: 我把手掌按在河底，感觉泥沙在动。
lines.en: I press my palm to the bed and feel the silt shifting.

lines.zh: 远处有船桨声，我沉下去一半。
lines.en: Oars sound in the distance and I sink halfway down.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，水从下巴往下滴。
lines.en: I look up at you, water dripping off my chin.

lines.zh: 我记得站在岸上的日子，那时我更高。
lines.en: I remember standing on land; I was taller then.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上，正好在我能扔到的距离。
lines.en: You stand on the bank, just within my throwing range.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，估算你到我的步数。
lines.en: I tilt my head and count the steps between us.

lines.zh: 我的眼白泛着浑，可我看得清你。
lines.en: My eyes are cloudy, but I see you clearly.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，我看了很久。
lines.en: I study what you are holding for a long time.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，水也不会让我眨眼。
lines.en: I do not blink, and the water will not make me.

lines.zh: 我记得你的脚步声，湿的。
lines.en: I remember your footsteps: wet ones.

lines.zh: 你后退了一步，我就往前挪半步。
lines.en: You step back once, so I shuffle half a step forward.

lines.zh: 我张嘴想说话，只吐出褐色的水。
lines.en: I open my mouth to speak and only brown water comes out.

lines.zh: 我挨了一下，水从我伤口里涌出来。
lines.en: I take a hit and water wells out of the wound.

lines.zh: 疼传得很慢，像水里的声音。
lines.en: The pain travels slowly, like sound underwater.

lines.zh: 你砍开我的皮，里面没有多少血。
lines.en: You split my skin and there is little blood inside.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，腐肉掉在水里。
lines.en: I step back and the rotten flesh drops into the water.

lines.zh: 这一击让我弯下腰，河水灌进领口。
lines.en: The blow bends me over and river water pours down my collar.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，牙缝里渗出浑水。
lines.en: I clench my teeth and cloudy water seeps between them.

lines.zh: 我的伤口不流血，只流河。
lines.en: My wound does not bleed; it only leaks the river.

lines.zh: 你打得我半边身子发麻。
lines.en: You hit me until half my body goes numb.

lines.zh: 我倒进浅水，压塌了一片泥。
lines.en: I fall into the shallows and crush a patch of mud.

lines.zh: 疼的时候我想起自己还活着。
lines.en: When it hurts, I remember I am still alive.

lines.zh: 你举着吃的，可我只想要腐肉。
lines.en: You hold out food, but I only want rotten flesh.

lines.zh: 活人的食物进了我的嘴，也是水的味道。
lines.en: Living food in my mouth still tastes like water.

lines.zh: 我不跟你走，除非你把腐肉丢下来。
lines.en: I will not follow unless you drop the rotten flesh.

lines.zh: 那个味道太干净了，我闻着不舒服。
lines.en: That smell is too clean; it unsettles me.

lines.zh: 我摇手，水从我袖口淌出来。
lines.en: I wave you off and water pours from my sleeve.

lines.zh: 你要喂我，不如喂河底的鱼。
lines.en: Feed the fish in the riverbed instead of me.

lines.zh: 我饿，但我不吃还会动的东西。
lines.en: I am hungry, but I do not eat things that still move.

lines.zh: 你把面包收起来吧，我只扔不吃。
lines.en: Put the bread away; I throw, I do not eat.

lines.zh: 我退进深水，让你够不着我。
lines.en: I back into deeper water so you cannot reach me.

lines.zh: 别拿甜的东西哄我，我尝不出甜。
lines.en: Do not coax me with sweets; I cannot taste sweet.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我身上的水全溅到你脸上。
lines.en: You bump me and all my water splashes your face.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀很硬，是泡久了的骨头。
lines.en: My shoulder is hard, bone soaked too long.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我手心一滑，腐肉掉了。
lines.en: We collide, my grip slips, and the flesh drops.

lines.zh: 我踉跄半步，踩塌了脚边的泥。
lines.en: I stagger half a step and crush the mud beneath me.

lines.zh: 你身上是干的，碰着我很不舒服。
lines.en: You are dry, and touching me feels wrong.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡了一下，水顺着胳膊甩出去。
lines.en: I raise an arm to block, flinging water off it.

lines.zh: 我的肋骨硌到你，你也硌到我。
lines.en: My ribs jab you, and yours jab me.

lines.zh: 我被撞得歪了，又慢慢直起来。
lines.en: I am knocked crooked and slowly straighten again.

lines.zh: 别贴这么近，我会把你拽下水。
lines.en: Do not stand so close; I will pull you in.

lines.zh: 我们分开时，你衣服上留下一片湿印。
lines.en: When we part, a wet mark stays on your clothes.

lines.zh: 我没有伴，只有水底的一堆骨头。
lines.en: I have no mate, only a pile of bones on the bed.

lines.zh: 你问这个做什么，我早就忘了。
lines.en: Why do you ask? I forgot that long ago.

lines.zh: 河里的同类不认我，我也不认它们。
lines.en: My kind in the river do not know me, nor I them.

lines.zh: 我张嘴想答，水先进来了。
lines.en: I open my mouth to answer and water gets in first.

lines.zh: 那种事要心跳，我的心早停了。
lines.en: That takes a heartbeat, and mine stopped long ago.

lines.zh: 我只和腐肉作伴，它不吵。
lines.en: I keep company with rotten flesh; it does not talk.

lines.zh: 你走开吧，这问题让我更冷。
lines.en: Go away; that question makes me colder.

lines.zh: 我也曾有过，后来沉进了泥里。
lines.en: I had one once, then it sank into the mud.

lines.zh: 我不找伴，我找能扔的东西。
lines.en: I am not looking for a mate, but for things to throw.

lines.zh: 水里没有谁会等我回去。
lines.en: No one in the water waits for me to return.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡起一块腐肉，水从指缝漏下。
lines.en: I bend and pick up rotten flesh, water leaking through my fingers.

lines.zh: 铜锭沉，我把它塞进腰间的袋。
lines.en: The copper ingot is heavy; I stuff it into my belt pouch.

lines.zh: 我捡东西很慢，手指泡得不听使唤。
lines.en: I pick things up slowly; soaked fingers will not obey.

lines.zh: 这块烂肉还带着别人的味道。
lines.en: This scrap of flesh still carries someone else's smell.

lines.zh: 我把东西捞起来，先在水里涮一涮。
lines.en: I fish the thing out and rinse it in the water first.

lines.zh: 铜在我手里发绿，我还是收着。
lines.en: The copper turns green in my hand; I keep it anyway.

lines.zh: 袋子里已经满了，我还是再塞一块。
lines.en: The pouch is full and I still cram in one more piece.

lines.zh: 有东西漂过来，我伸手一捞。
lines.en: Something drifts past and I reach out and scoop it up.

lines.zh: 我不挑，能扔的都算好东西。
lines.en: I am not picky; anything throwable counts as good.

lines.zh: 我低头闻了闻，然后放回袋里。
lines.en: I sniff it, then put it back in the pouch.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，手先摸向袋子。
lines.en: I see you, and my hand goes to the pouch first.

lines.zh: 这个距离刚好，我不用再走近。
lines.en: This distance is just right; I need not come closer.

lines.zh: 我抬起手臂，腐肉已经在掌心。
lines.en: I raise my arm with rotten flesh already in my palm.

lines.zh: 你身上有活人的热气，我盯上了。
lines.en: You carry living warmth, and I have locked on.

lines.zh: 我选你，因为你没在跑。
lines.en: I choose you because you are not running.

lines.zh: 河岸太窄，你躲不到哪里去。
lines.en: The bank is narrow; there is nowhere to dodge.

lines.zh: 我从水里起身，水顺着胳膊往下淌。
lines.en: I rise from the water and it streams down my arms.

lines.zh: 这一次我不扔偏，我在心里量过。
lines.en: This time I will not miss; I measured it in my head.

lines.zh: 你退到石头上，正好让我看清。
lines.en: You back onto the rocks, which lets me see you clearly.

lines.zh: 我的下巴收紧，水从牙缝里挤出来。
lines.en: My jaw tightens and water squeezes between my teeth.

lines.zh: 我认得这种怕，我很久以前也怕过。
lines.en: I know that fear; I felt it long ago.

lines.zh: 袋子还有七块，够你受的。
lines.en: Seven pieces left in the pouch, and all for you.

lines.zh: 我往前挪，水只到我膝盖。
lines.en: I move forward and the water only reaches my knees.

lines.zh: 你回头看一眼，我就知道你要跑。
lines.en: You glance back once, and I know you will run.

lines.zh: 你踩进浅水，腐肉已经攥紧。
lines.en: You step into the shallows with rotten flesh already gripped.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，把腐肉压在指节下。
lines.en: I turn sideways and pin the flesh under my knuckles.

lines.zh: 手臂往后拉，肩上的水被带起来。
lines.en: I draw my arm back, lifting water off my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的胸口，那里最容易中。
lines.en: I fix on your chest; that is the easiest place to hit.

lines.zh: 别动，我正在算你的高度。
lines.en: Hold still; I am calculating your height.

lines.zh: 我在水里站得很稳，比岸上稳。
lines.en: I stand steadier in water than on land.

lines.zh: 你举起盾，我就往你腿上扔。
lines.en: Raise your shield and I will throw at your legs.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩手腕，腐烂的汁水甩到身后。
lines.en: I flick my wrist and rotten juice spatters behind me.

lines.zh: 风从河面吹来，我要往上抬一点。
lines.en: Wind comes off the river; I must aim a little higher.

lines.zh: 你往左挪，我的手臂也跟着偏。
lines.en: You shift left, and my arm drifts with you.

lines.zh: 我嘴里发出咕噜声，那是数拍子。
lines.en: A gurgle comes from my mouth; that is me counting beats.

lines.zh: 我等着你眨眼，你一眨眼我就扔。
lines.en: I wait for you to blink, and when you do, I throw.

lines.zh: 这一下要用上腰，不只是胳膊。
lines.en: This throw needs my waist, not just my arm.

lines.zh: 腐肉在我手里已经开始散味。
lines.en: The rotten flesh is already reeking in my hand.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，让水只露出眼睛。
lines.en: I crouch until only my eyes show above the water.

lines.zh: 我把腐肉在掌心转了个面。
lines.en: I turn the rotten flesh over in my palm.

lines.zh: 你躲在船后面，我往高处扔。
lines.en: You hide behind the boat, so I lob higher.

lines.zh: 我的胳膊很沉，正合适。
lines.en: My arm is heavy, which suits the throw.

lines.zh: 你抬头看我，我就松手。
lines.en: Look up at me and I let go.

lines.zh: 腐肉脱手，在水面上打了个旋才飞出去。
lines.en: The flesh leaves my hand, spinning once over the water.

lines.zh: 我砸中你的肩，碎肉粘在你衣领上。
lines.en: I hit your shoulder and scraps stick to your collar.

lines.zh: 你偏头躲开，我的第二块已经到了。
lines.en: You duck aside, and my second piece is already there.

lines.zh: 我贴近了打，湿手拍在你脸上。
lines.en: I close in and slap your face with a wet hand.

lines.zh: 我的拳头带着水，砸下去很沉。
lines.en: My fist comes down heavy, carrying water with it.

lines.zh: 你被砸得后退，脚下溅起泥水。
lines.en: The blow drives you back and mud splashes underfoot.

lines.zh: 我不喊，出手时只有水声。
lines.en: I do not shout; there is only water noise when I strike.

lines.zh: 烂肉的味道在你身上散开了。
lines.en: The stink of rotten flesh spreads over you.

lines.zh: 我抓你的袖子，指甲里都是河泥。
lines.en: I grab your sleeve with river mud under my nails.

lines.zh: 你挡下一块，另一块从侧面来了。
lines.en: You block one piece; another comes from the side.

lines.zh: 我打得不准，但我不停下来。
lines.en: My aim is poor, but I do not stop.

lines.zh: 这一下我用上了整个肩膀。
lines.en: I put my whole shoulder into that one.

lines.zh: 你退进浅滩，我跟进水里。
lines.en: You retreat into the shallows and I follow into the water.

lines.zh: 我的手掌拍空了，水花溅得老高。
lines.en: My palm hits nothing and water sprays high.

lines.zh: 腐肉砸在你盾面上，散成一片。
lines.en: The flesh hits your shield and splatters.

lines.zh: 这一块打偏了，我立刻摸下一块。
lines.en: That one went wide, so I reach for the next.

lines.zh: 我在水下醒过来，肺里先灌满了水。
lines.en: I wake underwater with my lungs filling first.

lines.zh: 我原本在岸上走，后来水把我留下了。
lines.en: I used to walk on land; then the water kept me.

lines.zh: 我从河底站起来，身上挂着水草。
lines.en: I rise from the riverbed with weed hanging off me.

lines.zh: 铜的腥味从我指缝里透出来。
lines.en: The metallic reek of copper seeps from between my fingers.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，世界是绿的，晃的。
lines.en: I open my eyes and the world is green and wavering.

lines.zh: 我的第一口气是呛的，第二口就不用了。
lines.en: My first breath chokes me; I do not need a second.

lines.zh: 水流把我推到浅处，我就站住了。
lines.en: The current pushes me to the shallows and I find my feet.

lines.zh: 我记得自己投过很多次，手还记得。
lines.en: I remember throwing many times; my hand still remembers.

lines.zh: 腐肉在我袋里，我不知道是谁装的。
lines.en: Rotten flesh sits in my pouch; I do not know who filled it.

lines.zh: 我试着张嘴，声音闷在水里。
lines.en: I try to speak and my voice is muffled by water.

lines.zh: 岸上有光，我却先沉了下去。
lines.en: There is light on the bank, yet I sink first.

lines.zh: 我数了数手指，还是十根。
lines.en: I count my fingers: still ten.

lines.zh: 我身上有别人留下的伤口，已经白了。
lines.en: Old wounds left on me have gone white.

lines.zh: 我站直了，水从肩上滑下去。
lines.en: I straighten up and the water slides off my shoulders.

lines.zh: 火一碰我，我的皮就冒白汽，疼得钻心。
lines.en: Fire touches me, my skin steams white, and the pain is sharp.

lines.zh: 我从岸上摔下去，落地时水花盖住了我。
lines.en: I fall off the bank and the splash covers me on landing.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的头顶，我的胸口还是本能地一紧。
lines.en: Water closes over my head and my chest still tightens by instinct.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀出水面，腐肉散了一河。
lines.en: The blast throws me out of the water and flesh scatters down the river.

lines.zh: 箭钉进我的肩，我带着它继续走。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder and I keep walking with it.

lines.zh: 药水泼上来，我的皮肤开始起泡发黑。
lines.en: Potion splashes me and my skin blisters black.

lines.zh: 我饿得站不稳，袋子却还是满的。
lines.en: Hunger makes me sway, yet my pouch stays full.

lines.zh: 雷落在河面，我全身的水都在发抖。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the river and all the water in me shudders.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，我第一次觉得干。
lines.en: There is no water in the void, and for once I feel dry.
